changeSet.author: tarbank
changeSet.sql: SELECT setval( 'account_number_sequence', COALESCE(( SELECT MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(account_number FROM 3) AS BIGINT)) + 1 FROM accounts WHERE account_number ~ '^TB[0-9]{14}$' ), 1), false )
ALTER TABLE accounts ADD CONSTRAINT ck_accounts_number_shape CHECK (account_number ~ '^TB[0-9]{14}$')

ALTER TABLE accounts ADD CONSTRAINT ck_accounts_status_metadata CHECK ( (status_changed_by_manager_id IS NULL AND status_changed_at IS NULL) OR (status_changed_by_manager_id IS NOT NULL AND status_changed_at IS NOT NULL) )
ALTER TABLE accounts ADD CONSTRAINT ck_accounts_deactivation_metadata CHECK ((status = 'DEACTIVATED') = (deactivated_at IS NOT NULL))
CREATE TRIGGER trg_accounts_number_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OF account_number ON accounts FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION reject_account_number_update()
